title: Genesis 22:3-4 — On the third day Abraham saw the place from a distance
summary: Genesis 22:3-4 under the heading “The Akedah”: Abraham sets out with two young men and Isaac, and on the third day he raises his eyes and sees the place from a distance. The word “third” is enlarged in gold.

text.text: 3 So Abraham rose early in the morning and saddled his donkey, and took two of his young men with him and Isaac his son; and he split wood for the burnt offering, and arose and went to the place of which God had told him.
4 On the third day Abraham raised his eyes and saw the place from a distance.

numbers.note: two young men taken along (highlighted in green)
